gloss: pour forth in floods, flood away
definition: [ זָרַם ] verb pour forth in floods, flood away (Assyrian zarâmu , overwhelm , VR 36, 57 c Dl Pr 73 & in Zim BP 119 ) — Qal Perfect 2 masculine singular suffix זְרַמְתָּם Ps 90:5 thou floodest them with rain, sweepest them (men) away . Po. Perfect 3 plural זֹ֫רְמוּ מַ֫יִם עָבוֺת Ps 77:18 the cloud masses ( Che ) poured forth water .
